name: Springwater Special Situations Corp. Common stock
summary: Springwater Special Situations Corp. is a blank check company (SPAC) formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. SPACs do not have an initial business operation, and raise capital for the purpose of acquiring an existing company. The company is headquartered in Miami Beach, Florida.
